result.rule: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.
Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
Distinguish message tasks from message events: a task models performed work; an event models a message occurrence affecting flow.
Do not create separate pools for ordinary internal roles unless the description treats them as independent communicating participants.
Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.
Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.

When the description lists multiple distinct actions to be performed in sequence, including actions within one process stage: Model each distinct action as a separate BPMN activity and connect the activities in the described order; do not omit an action because it appears in a list.

When the description gives contextual details or examples alongside a single activity, without presenting them as separate actions: label the BPMN task with its core action and object; omit contextual details and qualifiers that are not needed to identify the activity

When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.

result.rule: When the description gives contextual details or examples alongside a single activity, without presenting them as separate actions: label the BPMN task with its core action and object; omit contextual details and qualifiers that are not needed to identify the activity

When the description states a core activity and separately describes a condition or later outcome that marks its completion: Label the BPMN activity with its core action and object; do not add the separately stated completion condition or later outcome to the activity label.
